deliverables: WP1 - Enabling Onchain Payments & Card Infrastructure
Smart contract engineering, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet/API ecosystem layer
Visa card issuance linked directly to on-chain balances
request.recipient: Intersect / 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract stake address stake1784sdxt6jjennmstphgdu7l7c2scf5d02a6cve2dgn5s2kq5u3j9v, submitted by Intersect on behalf of Wirex as vendor
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund Bringing Real-World Payments to Cardano with Wirex, described as full-stack open-source payments infrastructure connecting Cardano to on-chain settlement, banking rails, stablecoins, wallet interfaces, and Visa card issuance.

claims.claim: The proposal requests 3,961,538 ada, consisting of 3,846,153 ada for WP1 and 115,385 ada for an Intersect Budget Administration fee.
Wirex is proposed to deliver open-source payments infrastructure covering smart contracts, account abstraction, batched transactions, settlement logic, and wallet/API ecosystem components.
The proposed system is intended to enable Visa card issuance linked directly to on-chain balances so users can spend digital assets globally at millions of merchants.
Wirex is described as having 7 million users, over 1.5 million cards issued, more than 20 billion dollars in transaction volume, and Visa Principal Member experience.
The proposal states it achieved the required 67% support threshold during the 2026 Intersect Budget Process Hydra Voting phase.
The requested withdrawal is stated not to breach the applicable 350M Net Change Limit for Epoch 613 to Epoch 713 at the moment of submission.
Wirex is stated not to have received ada from the Cardano Treasury within the last 24 months.

Funds are to be administered through Intersect's 2026 Treasury Reserve Smart Contract and a Project-Specific Smart Contract, with specified stake/payment addresses and multi-party authorization requirements.

Oversight is described as including Intersect, technically capable third parties, reporting obligations, milestone-based disbursement controls, and an Oversight Committee of Sundae Labs, Cardano Foundation, Dquadrant, NMKR, Sundial, and Eternl.
The proposal claims it will increase Cardano network usage, user growth, institutional participation, and real-world economic activity on-chain.

summary: The document presents a 3,961,538 ada treasury request for Wirex payments infrastructure with stated governance-process support, NCL compliance, smart-contract fund administration, and oversight controls, but many adoption, execution, budget-adequacy, and impact claims are asserted rather than evidenced in the anchor text.
